en-US.lua_widget.api_balance_whale.name: Little Whale Balance Checker
en-US.lua_widget.api_balance_whale.description: View API balances and key quotas in whale or data mode.
en-US.lua_widget.api_balance_whale.key_hint: Stored encrypted locally; sent only to the selected provider.
